_about: Kit's model config. Agents and scheduled runs name a profile; profiles name a provider and a model. Change default_profile to change the default for everything. Per-agent files in models/<agent>.json win over the agents map below. After editing, run: kit-models check, then kit-models apply. Phase 1 uses Claude models only; the other providers are placeholders for phases 2 and 3. Move an agent off the default only after it passes its evals on the new profile. See models.example-routing.json for a proposed starting set.
